property_summary: For any nonzero amount sent by the owner to a nonzero receiver, C.sendTo either reverts (on failure) or succeeds and reduces address(c).balance by exactly amount; the mutant which ignores call return can succeed (not revert) while leaving c's balance unchanged when the callee reverts, violating this balance-change property.
change_summary: Changed transfer to a low-level call and ignored return value; this prevents automatic revert on failure and thus changes post-call state visibility.
